citation.source: Dalla Man C, Raimondo DM, Rizza RA, Cobelli C. GIM, simulation software of meal glucose-insulin model. J Diabetes Sci Technol. 2007; and the curated SBML, BioModels BIOMD0000000379
citation.locator: GIM: "45 g of glucose is ingested at 8 a.m., 70 g at noon, and 70 g at 8 p.m."; SBML: meal dose D = 78000 mg. The range spans the meal sizes the model's authors simulated; it is not a formal validation range.

citation.locator: "peripheral and hepatic insulin sensitivity (V_max and k_p3 in model, respectively)"; "peripheral and hepatic insulin sensitivity, which are set to 30% of the normal". V_max read as the whole maximum uptake rate, V_m0 + V_mX (named V_mmax in the curated SBML).
